profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer @Reshop
profile.summary: Experienced Full Stack Developer with a demonstrated history of delivering code in various corners of the software industry. Skilled in Javascript, Vue, React.js, Redux, Node.js, Express.js, jQuery, and lots more. Strong engineering professional with a Bachelor's degree focused in Spanish Language and Literature with a Minor in Computer Science from the University of Montana.
